response.overview: Roachelle recalls a passionate night of sex and love, guiding us through an intimate monologue that shifts from sensuality to something darker and more disturbing. As she reveals more details, what once seemed beautiful turns unsettling—even grotesque. The text, like her, becomes hard to watch and listen to. Between disgust, laughter, and discomfort, a strange reflection on desire and love emerges. And we already know: love is love, however it shows up.
response.title: El Amor Adecuado
